ValidationRule.description: If the record ISNEW, a validation rule should only allow the record to be created with a “Request Status” value of “Draft” or “Pending Assignment”.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISNEW() && NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) && NOT( ISPICKVAL(Request_Status__c, "Draft") || ISPICKVAL(Request_Status__c, "Pending Assignment") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only "Draft" or "Pending Assignment" can be selected as the Request Status for new records.
